title: Juicy Norwegian Barramundi Broth
description: A low-calorie, buttery, and juicy Norwegian dish perfect for a sick day, featuring barramundi cooked in a steamy broth. This dish is a traditional Norwegian recipe with a twist, using healthy ingredients to create a nourishing meal.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the warm fish stock, melted butter, chopped dill, chopped parsley, Norwegian aquavit (if using), salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Add the sliced baby carrots and potatoes to the pot, cooking for 10 minutes or until they are tender.
Meanwhile, prepare the barramundi fillets by seasoning them with salt and pepper.
Place a steamer basket over the pot, making sure it's not touching the liquid.
Add the barramundi fillets to the steamer basket, skin side down (if they have skin).
Cover the pot with a lid and steam the barramundi for 8-10 minutes or until it's cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the freshly squeezed lemon juice.
Serve the barramundi in bowls with the steamed vegetables and a ladle of the warm broth.
Garnish with additional chopped parsley and dill, if desired.
